Curve is a decentralized exchange that runs on public blockchains such as Ethereum. Curve operates automated market maker liquidity pools. Curve is optimized for swaps between stablecoins and other assets of similar value. Curve uses a governance token called CRV. Curve offers a vote-escrow mechanism in which users lock CRV to receive veCRV voting power.

Liquity is a decentralized borrowing protocol built on Ethereum. Liquity lets users borrow the LUSD stablecoin against ether collateral. Liquity charges no ongoing interest on loans. Liquity requires borrowers to keep their collateral above a minimum collateralization ratio. Liquity has no governance token and no admin keys that can change its core rules.

Mango Markets is a decentralized trading and lending platform built on the Solana blockchain. Mango Markets offers perpetual futures and margin trading. Mango Markets has a governance token called MNGO. Mango Markets was exploited in October 2022, resulting in large losses of funds.

USDe is a synthetic dollar stablecoin issued on Ethereum. USDe is backed by crypto collateral whose price exposure is hedged using derivatives. USDe is issued by Ethena Labs. USDe was launched in 2024.

1inch is a decentralized exchange aggregator that operates across multiple blockchains. 1inch routes trades across many liquidity sources to find favorable prices. 1inch has a governance token called 1INCH. 1inch offers a limit order protocol for users who set their own trade execution prices.
